title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the deteriorating situation of media freedom and freedom of expression in Hong Kong following the recent arrest of bookseller Leticia Wong and the convictions of Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung
part_text: Urges the Hong Kong authorities to immediately and unconditionally release Wong, Lee, Chow, Ho, Lai and all others detained for exercising their fundamental freedoms, including freedom of expression and assembly, and to drop all charges against them;
